description: Confirm that an ALLOWed payment settled. Requires the evaluation_id and the reservation_token returned by evaluate_payment, plus the real transaction/hash reference. Idempotent for the same evaluation; never call this before settlement.

evaluation_id.description: Evaluation identifier returned by an ALLOW verdict
evaluation_id.title: Evaluation Id

reservation_token.description: Private reservation capability returned with the evaluation; never log or publish it
reservation_token.title: Reservation Token

settlement_ref.description: Real transaction hash or facilitator settlement reference
settlement_ref.title: Settlement Ref

name: settle_evaluation
